messages:
leo: Putting together a short sync about egress contract + manifest SLA for Private deployments. Aim: set clear expectations for customers and field on IP stability, manifest signature, and upgrade windows. Want quick alignment before I raise a proposal doc.

leo: Core problem: customers ask for both low-friction installs and guarantees (egress IP stability, predictable upgrades). We can't promise everything for all install modes. Proposal: 3-level contract + manifest guarantees and an explicit rollback SLA.

anita: I like levels. We should call out the explicit invariants per level. Suggest: Level 1 = Relay (no egress SLA), Level 2 = Pin (guaranteed egress IP for pin_window), Level 3 = Sovereign (peering + IP preservation, requires route filters + signed manifest).

carlos: Important: Level 2 requires a pairing of customer-provided NAT pool OR Redwood-allocated pool with a lease. Need legal to approve customer SLA around IP churn and compensation if we break the pin. Also define monitoring windows for detection (eg. within 5m).

marie: Operational checklist for Level 3 (sovereign): ASN + peering details, route filters, mutual BFD recommended, manifest signature from customer netops, and a signed preflight report. Without the signature we don't consider the contract completed.

ops-bot: New ticket created: PRD-6122 "Egress contracts + manifest SLA" -> https://go/repo/PRD-6122 :spiral_calendar:

leo: Example manifest fragment (for Level 2 - pin):
```
manifest_version: 1
tenant: acme-corp
network_mode: pin
egress_strategy:
  type: pin
  pin_window_days: 7
nat_pool: customer_provided
manifest_hash: sha256:abc123...
```

anita: We also need RPCs and Console affordances: an API to request pin extension, a UI card showing current pin expiry, and an audit trail for any forced IP change. Field will ask for "why did my IP change?" so include a short reason code taxonomy.

carlos: Upgrade / rollback SLA proposal: upgrades are opt-in per-tenant. If an upgrade fails connectivity checks we automatically revert within 10 minutes; otherwise, field can trigger revert and we promise to complete within 1 hour (GA goal). Need ops runbook for manual corner cases.

marie: For air-gapped customers, preflight must produce a signed preflight-report.json plus a manifest-signature artifact. Field signs and returns, we verify signature before applying. Add test: replay report verifier in CI.

leo: Launch gates (draft):
- Gate 1: Level 1 (Relay) GA: preflight smoke, console visibility, 2 pilot customers
- Gate 2: Level 2 (Pin) Beta: pin API + pin expiry UI + ip-stability telemetry + legal sign-off on SLA
- Gate 3: Level 3 (Sovereign) Field release: peering runbook, signed manifest flow, security/legal + 3 field pilots

anita: Acceptance criteria for Level 2 Beta: stable egress over 7-day pin in 3 test topologies, automatic revert triggers tested, and console shows pin expiry + reason codes.

carlos: Telemetry we need: egress_ip_change_count, pin_extension_requests, auto_revert_count, manifest_apply_latency, and preflight_verification_status. We'll wire these into Redwood Console and add alerting for auto_revert_count > 0 in prod.

marie: Owners: manifest signing + verification -> security (marie); pin API + backend -> network (carlos); console + UX -> product (leo); legal/terms -> contracts (anita).

ops-bot: PRD-6122 labels updated: +egress-sla +private-deploy +due 2026-06-20

leo: Action items:
- anita: engage contracts/legal on compensation and churn SLAs (owner)
- carlos: design pin API + telemetry schema (owner)
- marie: design manifest signature flow + CI verifier (owner)
- leo: draft RFC + field runbook + pilot outreach (owner)

leo: If no objections I'll convert this into a RFC and attach a short acceptance test matrix. React with :thumbsup: or reply with objections.

anita: :+1: will loop in contracts

carlos: :+1: will sketch API by EOW

marie: :+1: will prototype verifier in CI pipeline

leo: Thanks all 44d will file RFC after lunch.
